purpose: Teach: 女子高/シドニー/和歌山/栃木/カレッジ/薫/ヴィンチ/ヤン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏休み、シドニーの語学カレッジ申し込んでみたよ。
lines.en: For summer, I applied to a language college in Sydney.
lines.style: Quick, proud announcement with a lift at the end. Eyes bright. The kind of thing you say when you've been sitting on it and it's finally real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジか。うちの女子高、留学制度あったっけ?
lines.en: For real? Did our school even have an exchange program?
lines.style: Genuine surprise—eyebrows up. Quick intake. Impressed, a little envious. Not quite believing it until she confirms.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちの分校が栃木にあって、姉妹校提携の関係で枠があるんだって。
lines.en: Our branch campus is in Tochigi, and through the sister-school partnership there are slots available.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact explanation, slightly proud of having done the homework. Calm, authoritative—the person who read the fine print.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいなあ。俺、和歌山のおばあちゃん家、夏は薫る梅の香りが最高なんだ。
lines.en: That's cool. My grandma's place in Wakayama—the plum blossoms in summer smell incredible.
lines.style: Soft, distant for a moment. Genuinely warm memory surfacing. Slower pace, almost absent. Not showing off, just remembering something good.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 梅の香りいいね。シドニーで美術館行って、ダ・ヴィンチ展も見るつもり。
lines.en: Plum scent is really nice. While I'm in Sydney I'm definitely hitting the art museums—there's a da Vinci exhibition.
lines.style: Animated again, plans clicking into place. Energy returning. Words come faster. Genuine excitement about the specifics.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おお、本格的。お土産はヤング系の雑誌とかでいいから。
lines.en: Whoa, you're really doing this. Just grab me a magazine—something trendy, whatever.
lines.style: Casual, almost deflecting with humor. Small laugh underneath. Trying not to show how much he wants her to go.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 了解!帰国したら和歌山も連れてって。
lines.en: Done. When I'm back, you're taking me to Wakayama.
lines.style: Light, certain. A promise and a plan landing at the same time. Warm close—not asking, stating it like it's already decided.
